QuestInfo.name: What Rots Below
QuestInfo.1: The #r#o700003##k at the back of #b#m10006121##k is the biggest thing the rot has taken. #b#p717##k wants it gone so her house can rest. I should defeat it and bring its #b#t4000065##k back as proof.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #o700003# and showed #p717# its #t4000065#. The house is quiet again.

0.0: The ward is holding, so I could finally look at the back of the grave. The #r#o700003##k is still there, bigger than ever.
0.1: I've watched it for years. It was only a mushroom once, and the rot has swallowed it whole. It's the worst of them, and it's moving closer to my door.
0.2: Please defeat it, and bring me its #b#t4000065##k so I know it's gone. The rot won't end with it, but the house can rest.

yes.0: Thank you! It's right outside, at #b#m10006121##k. Please be careful. It's much bigger than you'd think.

no.0: I understand... I'll keep my light low and hope it doesn't notice me.

1.0: You're back! And that's... its cap! You really did it!
1.1: I can already feel the air getting lighter. The rot is still down there, but maybe the house can be warm again.
1.2: I don't have much, but the fairies left this behind. Please take it.

item.0: The #r#o700003##k is right outside, at #b#m10006121##k. I need to see its #b#t4000065##k.
